# Description & Notes:
#   California Current Reconstruction from Benthic Isotopes and Alkenone Temperatures
#   Isotope Data analytical error is ~0.1 per mil. The Uk'37 data have an analytical
#   precision equal to +- 0.15 Degrees Celsius. The age model comes from tuning benthic
#   delta 18O to an orbital age model.
#
